title: Markus pipeline breaks against published anthus-markus 0.5.0: document IR is unreleased

comments.author: home
comments.text:
SEVERITY: this breaks the Markus render path on any machine that installs Markus from PyPI. Found while re-orienting after the rate-limit gap.

THE FACTS, ALL VERIFIED DIRECTLY:
- The ACTIVE markusmd in this environment is 0.5.0 from /Users/home/miniconda3/lib/python3.12/site-packages - NOT the Markus repo. The editable install that existed earlier is gone. 'pip show anthus-markus' reports Version 0.5.0, Location site-packages, no editable marker.
- Published 0.5.0 does NOT contain the document IR. There is no blocks.py in the installed package.
- Running 'markus ast' under installed 0.5.0 returns the OLD directive-only AST: schema_version is ABSENT, and top-level children come back as ['markdown','directive','markdown','directive','markdown'] - opaque raw-source blobs, not typed block nodes.
- Papyrus lib/markus-ir.ts declares MARKUS_IR_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1 and THROWS MarkusSchemaVersionError when the ingested schema_version does not match. Against 0.5.0 the field is undefined, so it throws.
- The document IR exists ONLY on the local, UNPUSHED Markus branch feature/document-ir (/Users/home/Projects/Markus, 10 commits ahead of origin/main, 0 pushed). origin/main does not have blocks.py either.

CONSEQUENCE: the Papyrus Markus pipeline works only on a machine where that unpushed local branch happens to be installed. Any clean checkout, any CI runner, any Amplify build that does 'pip install anthus-markus' gets 0.5.0 and fails at the IR boundary. The current production site was presumably built from the local branch or from pre-generated dist output, which masks this.

THE GOOD NEWS: the schema_version check is doing exactly its job - it fails loudly at the boundary instead of silently mis-parsing. That is the design working.

WHAT NEEDS TO HAPPEN (decision required from Ryan):
1. Push Markus feature/document-ir and merge it to main. It is reviewed and green: 168 behave scenarios pass, ruff clean, markus convert output byte-identical vs main.
2. Release it as anthus-markus 0.6.0 (the IR is an additive feature; schema_version 1 is new).
3. Pin Papyrus's Python dependency to that minimum version so the failure is a clear install-time resolution error rather than a runtime schema throw.
Until 1-3 happen, treat any 'the Markus build works' result as environment-specific and not reproducible.

ALSO ON THAT UNPUSHED BRANCH and therefore equally unreleased: the front-matter date/datetime ISO-8601 serialization fix (kanbus-dacb70), the YAML sexagesimal corruption fix (kanbus-2ecaf7 - bare HH:MM:SS silently becoming an integer), and the two-up mobile collapse fix (kanbus-703c7d). All three matter for real newsroom content.
